query: Please implement a data entry website for inputting and managing data. The website should have functionalities for data entry, data viewing, data editing, and data deletion. Users should be able to log in, input new data, view existing data, edit existing data, and delete unnecessary data. Configure all backgrounds with light slate gray and all components with navy.
